theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_lipschitz_smoothing
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : NNReal) (σ : ℝ), LipschitzWith K g → 0 < σ → ∃ g' : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g' ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g' x‖ ≤ K) ∧ (∀ x, |g' x - g x| ≤ K * σ) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclid P) (c : ℝ), (∀ y ∈ ball x σ, g y = c) → g' x = c
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
